cam.title: Scan cargo with camera
cam.tip: Keep an A4 sheet next to the boxes — it shows the size
cam.blocked: Camera didn't open? Allow the camera for this site, or pick a photo from the gallery.
cam.tooLarge: This photo is too large — take it again
cam.failed: Couldn't read the photos — try again or type it

voice.title: Speak the cargo
voice.example: Say: “60 by 40 by 45 carton, 16 pieces, 12 kg, fragile”
voice.typeHelp: Example: 60 by 40 by 45 cm, 16 pieces, 12 kg
voice.noSpeech: Speaking works in Chrome or Edge — type it here instead
voice.nothing: Didn't catch that — try again or type it

voice.failed: Couldn't read that — try again or type it
voice.answerHelp: Say or type, e.g. “20” or “2 feet” (cm if no unit)
